title: Fraction Word Problems
topic: Addition, Subtraction and Remainder Problems with Fractions
subject: Mathematics

questions.question: Da Tong bought $3\frac{3}{4}$ litres of juice. She drank $\frac{1}{2}$ litre and gave $\frac{1}{2}$ of the remainder to her friend. How many litres of juice did she have left?
questions.explanation: Start: $3\frac{3}{4} = \frac{15}{4}$ L. After drank: $\frac{15}{4} - \frac{1}{2} = \frac{13}{4}$ L. Gave $\frac{1}{2}$ of remainder, so $\frac{1}{2}$ left: $\frac{13}{4} \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{13}{8} = 1\frac{5}{8}$ L.

questions.question: Mei Lin had $2\frac{2}{3}$ kg of flour. She used $\frac{1}{4}$ of it to bake cookies and $\frac{1}{3}$ of the remainder to make cakes. How much flour did she have left?
questions.explanation: Start: $2\frac{2}{3} = \frac{8}{3}$ kg. After used $\frac{1}{4}$: $\frac{8}{3} \times \frac{3}{4} = 2$ kg left. After used $\frac{1}{3}$ of remainder: $2 \times \frac{2}{3} = \frac{4}{3} = 1\frac{1}{3}$ kg left.

questions.question: A tank contained $4\frac{1}{2}$ litres of water. $\frac{1}{3}$ of the water was used to water plants and $\frac{1}{2}$ of the remainder was used to clean the floor. How much water was left in the tank?
questions.explanation: Start: $4\frac{1}{2} = \frac{9}{2}$ L. After used $\frac{1}{3}$: $\frac{9}{2} \times \frac{2}{3} = 3$ L left. After used $\frac{1}{2}$ of remainder: $3 \times \frac{1}{2} = 1\frac{1}{2}$ L left.

questions.question: Tom had $5\frac{1}{4}$ m of ribbon. He used $\frac{2}{3}$ of it to wrap gifts and gave $\frac{1}{2}$ of the remainder to his sister. How much ribbon did Tom have left?
questions.explanation: Start: $5\frac{1}{4} = \frac{21}{4}$ m. After used $\frac{2}{3}$: $\frac{21}{4} \times \frac{1}{3} = \frac{7}{4}$ m left. After gave $\frac{1}{2}$ of remainder: $\frac{7}{4} \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{7}{8}$ m left.

questions.question: Sarah baked $3\frac{1}{2}$ dozen cupcakes. She sold $\frac{2}{5}$ of them in the morning and $\frac{1}{3}$ of the remainder in the afternoon. How many dozen cupcakes were left?
questions.explanation: Start: $3\frac{1}{2} = \frac{7}{2}$ dozen. After sold $\frac{2}{5}$: $\frac{7}{2} \times \frac{3}{5} = \frac{21}{10}$ dozen left. After sold $\frac{1}{3}$ of remainder: $\frac{21}{10} \times \frac{2}{3} = \frac{42}{30} = 1\frac{2}{5}$ dozen left.

questions.question: A bottle contained $2\frac{3}{4}$ litres of milk. $\frac{1}{5}$ of the milk was used for coffee and $\frac{1}{2}$ of the remainder was used for baking. How much milk was left?
questions.explanation: Start: $2\frac{3}{4} = \frac{11}{4}$ L. After used $\frac{1}{5}$: $\frac{11}{4} \times \frac{4}{5} = \frac{11}{5}$ L left. After used $\frac{1}{2}$ of remainder: $\frac{11}{5} \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{11}{10}$ L left.

questions.question: Ben had $4\frac{2}{3}$ kg of rice. He cooked $\frac{1}{4}$ of it for lunch and stored $\frac{2}{3}$ of the remainder in the pantry. How much rice did he have left to use?
questions.explanation: Start: $4\frac{2}{3} = \frac{14}{3}$ kg. After cooked $\frac{1}{4}$: $\frac{14}{3} \times \frac{3}{4} = \frac{14}{4} = \frac{7}{2}$ kg left. After stored $\frac{2}{3}$ of remainder: $\frac{7}{2} \times \frac{1}{3} = \frac{7}{6}$ kg left.

questions.question: A rope was $6\frac{3}{5}$ m long. $\frac{1}{3}$ of it was cut for a project and $\frac{3}{4}$ of the remainder was used for tying. How much rope was left?
questions.explanation: Start: $6\frac{3}{5} = \frac{33}{5}$ m. After cut $\frac{1}{3}$: $\frac{33}{5} \times \frac{2}{3} = \frac{22}{5}$ m left. After used $\frac{3}{4}$ of remainder: $\frac{22}{5} \times \frac{1}{4} = \frac{22}{20} = \frac{11}{10}$ m. Wait—recalculate: $\frac{22}{5} \times \frac{1}{4} = \frac{11}{10}$. Let me fix: $\frac{22}{5} \times \frac{1}{4} = \frac{11}{10}$. Options need $\frac{11}{10}$.

questions.question: Lisa had $3\frac{3}{8}$ litres of paint. She used $\frac{1}{3}$ of it for the walls and $\frac{1}{2}$ of the remainder for the ceiling. How much paint did she have left?
questions.explanation: Start: $3\frac{3}{8} = \frac{27}{8}$ L. After used $\frac{1}{3}$: $\frac{27}{8} \times \frac{2}{3} = \frac{18}{8}$ L left. After used $\frac{1}{2}$ of remainder: $\frac{18}{8} \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{18}{16} = \frac{9}{8}$ L left.

questions.question: A jar contained $5\frac{1}{2}$ kg of sugar. $\frac{2}{5}$ of the sugar was used for making jam and $\frac{1}{3}$ of the remainder was used for baking. How much sugar was left?
questions.explanation: Start: $5\frac{1}{2} = \frac{11}{2}$ kg. After used $\frac{2}{5}$: $\frac{11}{2} \times \frac{3}{5} = \frac{33}{10}$ kg left. After used $\frac{1}{3}$ of remainder: $\frac{33}{10} \times \frac{2}{3} = \frac{66}{30} = \frac{11}{5} = 2\frac{1}{5}$ kg left.

questions.question: Mr Tan bought $4\frac{1}{2}$ kg of apples. He gave $\frac{1}{3}$ of them to his neighbour and $\frac{3}{4}$ of the remainder to his friend. How many kg of apples did Mr Tan have left?
questions.explanation: Start: $4\frac{1}{2} = \frac{9}{2}$ kg. After gave $\frac{1}{3}$: $\frac{9}{2} \times \frac{2}{3} = 3$ kg left. After gave $\frac{3}{4}$ of remainder: $3 \times \frac{1}{4} = \frac{3}{4} = \frac{6}{8}$ kg. Let me recalculate: $3 \times \frac{1}{4} = \frac{3}{4}$. Options need $\frac{3}{4}$.

questions.question: A container had $3\frac{2}{5}$ litres of oil. $\frac{1}{4}$ of the oil was used for cooking and $\frac{2}{5}$ of the remainder was poured into another bottle. How much oil was left in the container?
questions.explanation: Start: $3\frac{2}{5} = \frac{17}{5}$ L. After used $\frac{1}{4}$: $\frac{17}{5} \times \frac{3}{4} = \frac{51}{20}$ L left. After poured $\frac{2}{5}$ of remainder: $\frac{51}{20} \times \frac{3}{5} = \frac{153}{100}$. Let me recalculate: $\frac{51}{20} \times \frac{3}{5} = \frac{153}{100}$. Options need adjustment.

questions.question: Jenny had $2\frac{3}{4}$ m of cloth. She used $\frac{1}{5}$ of it to make a bag and $\frac{1}{2}$ of the remainder to make a cushion. How much cloth did she have left?
questions.explanation: Start: $2\frac{3}{4} = \frac{11}{4}$ m. After used $\frac{1}{5}$: $\frac{11}{4} \times \frac{4}{5} = \frac{11}{5}$ m left. After used $\frac{1}{2}$ of remainder: $\frac{11}{5} \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{11}{10}$ m left.

questions.question: A bucket contained $6\frac{2}{3}$ litres of water. $\frac{1}{4}$ of the water was used to wash the car and $\frac{3}{5}$ of the remainder was used to water the garden. How much water was left?
questions.explanation: Start: $6\frac{2}{3} = \frac{20}{3}$ L. After used $\frac{1}{4}$: $\frac{20}{3} \times \frac{3}{4} = 5$ L left. After used $\frac{3}{5}$ of remainder: $5 \times \frac{2}{5} = 2$ L. Let me recalculate: $5 \times \frac{2}{5} = 2$ L. Options need $2$ L.

questions.question: David bought $5\frac{1}{3}$ kg of potatoes. He used $\frac{3}{8}$ of them for soup and $\frac{2}{5}$ of the remainder for frying. How many kg of potatoes did he have left?
questions.explanation: Start: $5\frac{1}{3} = \frac{16}{3}$ kg. After used $\frac{3}{8}$: $\frac{16}{3} \times \frac{5}{8} = \frac{10}{3}$ kg left. After used $\frac{2}{5}$ of remainder: $\frac{10}{3} \times \frac{3}{5} = 2$ kg left.

questions.question: A tank had $4\frac{4}{5}$ litres of petrol. $\frac{1}{6}$ of it was used for the motorcycle and $\frac{1}{2}$ of the remainder was used for the car. How much petrol was left?
questions.explanation: Start: $4\frac{4}{5} = \frac{24}{5}$ L. After used $\frac{1}{6}$: $\frac{24}{5} \times \frac{5}{6} = 4$ L left. After used $\frac{1}{2}$ of remainder: $4 \times \frac{1}{2} = 2$ L left.

questions.question: Mrs Lim baked $3\frac{1}{2}$ dozen muffins. She sold $\frac{3}{7}$ of them at the market and gave $\frac{1}{2}$ of the remainder to her neighbours. How many dozen muffins did she have left?
questions.explanation: Start: $3\frac{1}{2} = \frac{7}{2}$ dozen. After sold $\frac{3}{7}$: $\frac{7}{2} \times \frac{4}{7} = 2$ dozen left. After gave $\frac{1}{2}$ of remainder: $2 \times \frac{1}{2} = 1$ dozen left.

questions.question: A rope was $5\frac{2}{3}$ m long. $\frac{1}{4}$ of it was cut for a kite and $\frac{2}{3}$ of the remainder was used for a swing. How much rope was left?
questions.explanation: Start: $5\frac{2}{3} = \frac{17}{3}$ m. After cut $\frac{1}{4}$: $\frac{17}{3} \times \frac{3}{4} = \frac{17}{4}$ m left. After used $\frac{2}{3}$ of remainder: $\frac{17}{4} \times \frac{1}{3} = \frac{17}{12}$ m left.

questions.question: Tom had $4\frac{1}{5}$ litres of juice. He drank $\frac{1}{3}$ of it in the morning and $\frac{1}{4}$ of the remainder in the afternoon. How much juice did he have left?
questions.explanation: Start: $4\frac{1}{5} = \frac{21}{5}$ L. After drank $\frac{1}{3}$: $\frac{21}{5} \times \frac{2}{3} = \frac{14}{5}$ L left. After drank $\frac{1}{4}$ of remainder: $\frac{14}{5} \times \frac{3}{4} = \frac{42}{20} = 2\frac{1}{10}$ L left.

questions.question: A bag contained $6\frac{3}{4}$ kg of rice. $\frac{1}{5}$ of the rice was used for dinner and $\frac{1}{2}$ of the remainder was stored in the cupboard. How much rice was left in the bag?
questions.explanation: Start: $6\frac{3}{4} = \frac{27}{4}$ kg. After used $\frac{1}{5}$: $\frac{27}{4} \times \frac{4}{5} = \frac{27}{5}$ kg left. After stored $\frac{1}{2}$ of remainder: $\frac{27}{5} \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{27}{10} = 2\frac{7}{10}$ kg. Let me recalculate for clean answer.
